architecture_selection_rule: If the difference between the two mean F1 scores is greater than 0.005, select the highest mean F1.
Otherwise, select the lowest sample standard deviation of F1 across the five seeds.
If the standard deviations are exactly equal, select the network with fewer trainable parameters.
If a tie still remains, select the candidate name first in alphabetical order.
export_seed_rule: For the selected architecture, choose the seed whose validation F1 is closest to that architecture's mean F1.
If two seeds are equally close, choose the smallest numeric seed.
final_epoch_rule: Use the median best validation epoch observed across the five seeds, rounded to the nearest existing integer value.
final_training_rule: Refit a new TF-IDF vectorizer on the complete 60 percent training pool only.
Retrain the selected architecture on that complete training pool with the frozen seed and frozen epoch count.
Do not use final-test or production rows for fitting the vectorizer, the model, the threshold, or any hyperparameter.
final_test_policy: Transform the final test with the frozen vectorizer exactly once.
Run one final metric campaign with the frozen model and threshold 0.50.
Do not alter preprocessing, architecture, seed, epoch count, threshold, or hyperparameters after seeing final-test results.
production_policy: Keep production_holdout sealed and do not calculate evaluation metrics on it.
pedagogical_margin_policy: Report the required approximation but do not use it as a model-selection rule.
